title: Earl Warren's absence and the new trumpets
summary: They trace Earl Warren, Snooky Young, J. J. Johnson and others, and wonder when the draft ended.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Where did Earl Warren go when he left? Now you've got Preston Love and George Dorsey on altos.
Warren -- did he come back? Did Earl come back?
Earl came back, I think -- yeah. But, Preston Love was in there for quite a while.
What happened to Earl?
Well, did Earl go in the Army?
I think he did. I think he went into the Army.
He must have. He must have. Where else could -- I can't think of any place else he could have gone, you know?
Yeah. To work for anyone else?
Yeah. No. He didn't work for anybody else.
Then you've got Snooky Young in the trumpet section.
Mm hmm.
J. J. Johnson.
Mm hmm.
My God. All these changes in --
Oh, yeah.
-- but, how many years? I mean, is this one year after another?
Well --
And, you've got Emmett Berry in the band.
Well, listen. Hold on a minute. Let's stop just a second, because by '45 people weren't going in the Army then.
(Untrue - the draft ended in 1946)
Mm.
I guess they were...
They were coming out.
What year was that? That Earl Warren left?
'45 -- January. And, August '45 you've got Ed Lewis, Sweets, Snooky Young, Emmett Berry,
Mm hmm.
Ted Donnelly, W.W. Wilkinson, Eli and Dizzy Wells.
Mm hmm.
Preston Love, George Dorsey, Buddy Tate, and --
What year is that now?
'45. Illinois Jacquet, Rudy Rutherford, Rodney Richardson, Shadow Wilson.
I'm wondering what happened to Earl during that period. Was he still in the Army do you think?
I should think so.
He must have been.
He might not have got out till '46.
Yeah, well he was probably still there, then. Buddy Tate was still there?
Buddy's still there -- with Illinois Jacquet.
Uh-huh.
And, you've got this great trumpet section -- Ed Lewis, Harry Edison, Snooky, and Emmett Berry.
Mm hmm.
Well, that sounds like a good band.
That was a good band. That band was good.
